html:
Hello

here is a black and white image taken in the hydrogen alpha wavelength of the Monkey Nebula at lower left (NGC 2175) and the Jellyfish Nebula at the center (IC443). The family portrait is completed by the open cluster Messier 35 at lower right. North is to the right.



Date:  2011/02/12 
Optical train = Nikkor 80-200 ED f2.8 lens @ 200mm f4.0 - Astronomik Ha 12nm filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSky6 software
Site: At home
18 exposures of 10 min for 180 minutes
Flat and bias applied
PixInsight
Unguided mount

Here is the result of the "Plate solving"
